entries.headline: Ads keywords tightened for winter; GHL source tracking corrected
entries.text:
*Quality HVAC: work report, Nov 12–18*

Ads keywords tightened for winter; GHL source tracking corrected

*Done this week*
• *Ads:* Refined the winter campaign keywords: cut the list from 34 to 11, added 6 high-intent searches (furnace repair, no heat, emergency repair, furnace tune-up), and paused keywords that spent budget without producing leads.
• *Ads:* Added negative keywords to block competitor names, troubleshooting searches, and equipment-shopping queries so budget focuses on people ready to book.
• *CRM & automations:* Fixed contact source attribution in the CRM: tags and lead sources are now assigned automatically based on where each contact comes from, replacing the manual process.

*In progress*
• *Ads:* Auditing the web lead tracking flow to ensure campaign and channel data is correctly captured and passed through on all paid traffic pages, so every form submission is properly attributed.
• *Google listings:* Burr Ridge Google listing verification is still pending — waiting on the new signage to be installed before the live video verification step can be completed.
• *Website & SEO:* Google Business Profile posting has been restarted for both Quality HVAC and Fibid after a gap since 9/29; first posts are being prepared this week with a weekly seasonal heating cadence planned going forward.

*Waiting on you*
• *Google listings:* Burr Ridge verification: once the new "Fibid Heating & Air Conditioning" signage (door, lobby directory, and inside decal) is installed, please let us know so we can walk you through the Google live video verification from your own login.

*Coming up next*
• *Ads:* Complete the web lead tracking audit and confirm UTM/source parameters are visible on every lead record.
• *Website & SEO:* Publish the first Google Business Profile post for Quality HVAC and Fibid and confirm the planned weekly posting day for each.
